## HISTOPLASMA CAPSULATUM
Intravenous antifungals are indicated initially for severe or progressive
disease. After disease has stabilized, oral antifungals may be used to complete
the course. Contact Infectious Diseases and Pulmonary services for advice.
Contact HIV expert for advice on cases involving patients with HIV.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Duration of therapy is dependent upon location and severity of infection,
and response to therapy. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.
## Preferred initial therapy for meningitis, severe pulmonary or disseminated
## disease
## Treatment after disease has stabilized
Itraconazole is more effective than fluconazole, but fluconazole may be used in
patients who cannot tolerate itraconazole.
Preferred
[Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-itraconazole-200mg-po-q12h)
Alternative
[Fluconazole 400-800 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-fluconazole-400mg-po-q24h)
